result.description: Visual discovery and social platform; API v5 lets apps manage pins, boards, ads, catalogs and analytics for users and businesses.
result.auth_detail: REST API v5 uses OAuth 2.0: authorization code grant (full capabilities, user auth) and client credentials (limited, app-only, needs 2FA). Refresh tokens are continuous (60-day expiry). Trial-approved apps can also generate a 24-hour test access token without the OAuth flow.
result.access_detail: Free to register, but Pinterest reviews every app. Approved apps get Trial access, where pins and boards are sandbox-only and visible just to their creator. Standard access, needed to serve other users, requires a separate review with a demo video of the OAuth flow.
result.api_notes: REST API v5. OAuth scope table covers ads, billing, biz_access, boards, catalogs, pins and user_accounts, each with read and write scopes. Breadth is inferred from the scope table. The v5 overview page returned only site navigation, so I did not read the endpoint list. Trial access has per-day rate limits. Apps registered on or after 2026-09-14 may get 403 PINNER_DATA_ACCESS_DENIED for boards and pins of non-business users without Pinterest authorization.
result.blocker: Pinterest must approve each app for Trial access, then review it again for Standard access, which needs a demo video of the OAuth flow, before other users can connect. Trial content stays sandbox-only. Details of the official MCP server (endpoint, auth, availability) were not verified.

evidence.quote: Our implementation of grant types and access tokens follows OAuth 2.0 specifications.
This grant type is designed for situations when the client (your app) is acting on its own behalf, not a user.
Once your app is approved for Trial access you can generate a token to test the API without setting up the Oauth flow.
Application requests are reviewed by Pinterest.
If approved for API use, your app receives Trial access, which is best for exploring our API features.
Your app must already be approved for Trial access and comply with our Developer Guidelines.
Prepare a video recording of your app completing an action using the Pinterest API.
Pinterest API services are only available to authenticated and authorized users.
Pinterest is bringing its data and Ads capabilities directly into the AI tools teams already use.
